summary.text: Customers find these shower steamers make great gifts that transform daily showers into luxurious spa experiences. The products receive positive feedback for their relaxation benefits, with one customer noting they instantly feel calm. However, there are mixed opinions about their effectiveness, with some saying they work wonders while others report they don't work at all. Moreover, customers disagree on the duration, with some reporting they last the whole shower while others say they don't last long. Additionally, the fragrance, value for money, and dissolvability receive mixed reviews, with some finding them well worth the money while others say they don't work in their showers.
